name: com.noopsoftworks.wildcat
description: Client SDK for the WildCat game backend: sessions, accounts, friends, challenges, matchmaking, relay matches, leaderboards, inventory, cloud data and server script events over one WebSocket. Task-based API with request timeouts, heartbeats and automatic reconnection.

samples.description: Connect, log in with a device id, find a match, relay positions between two clients, submit a score through a script event, read a leaderboard and handle friend invitations.
